settings.label: Connect failover partners at login
settings.description: Checks access to all failover partners right after login. Otherwise the partner is contacted only when needed.

settings.label: Check the server after login
settings.description: Starts the server check in the background after login.

settings.label: Replicate changes automatically
settings.description: After every change on a failover scope the scope is synchronised to the partner.

settings.label: Expert mode
settings.description: Shows the Definitions page (create, change and delete option definitions). Editing still has to be unlocked there.

settings.label: Stored credentials
settings.description: Used when "Stored credentials" is selected at login. Stored encrypted in the vault.
